estimate_warning: Criterion values and weights are new uncalibrated design judgments, not measurements. They support review and do not establish empirical reliability, acceptance or source authority.

candidates.label: Incremental native composition
candidates.primary_failure_mode: Wrong or skipped skill; missing hook coverage.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat: native intent selects the decision workflow and its actual owners. Spec: authoring workflow plus tested path/operation constraints.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: current state and source hashes recover through a supported boundary; receipt remains separate from correctness.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select when P1 misses material cases and a bounded workflow improves outcomes. Avoid expanding if it adds no useful benefit.

candidates.label: Improve existing native files only
candidates.primary_failure_mode: Judgment reference omitted despite a correct pointer.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat: current XML prompts the model to open the owner directly. Spec: repaired routing/pointers guide the same direct read.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: existing iterative/handover files preserve state; no new receipts or runtime layer.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select when existing mechanisms meet the same cases. Keep as fallback. Avoid claiming it mechanically enforces missed semantic routes.

candidates.label: All references as independent skills
candidates.primary_failure_mode: Conflicting descriptions or selection of a definition fragment.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat: the model chooses QA and bake-off skills separately. Spec: it must choose authoring, task fields and schemas without double-loading.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: many metadata entries compete; source bodies remain authoritative references.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select if same-content tests show improved routing with tolerable metadata cost. Avoid when irrelevant selection or source drift increases.

candidates.label: Native scoped rules/direct refs
candidates.primary_failure_mode: No path event for a chat-only decision; divergent descendant behavior.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat: depends on core/direct-reference recognition. Spec: verified native path scope supplies the appropriate rule.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: recovery relies on existing current-state files; scope does not choose evidence by task meaning.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select for stable file families with proven loaders. Avoid as the sole mechanism for conversational activation.

candidates.label: One multi-task Apex skill
candidates.primary_failure_mode: The monolith is chosen but a branch is skipped or irrelevant detail loaded.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat and spec both invoke the same entrypoint, which branches into existing owner references.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: the entrypoint can restore state, but broad scope makes selection and retention harder to diagnose.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select only as a thin orientation entrypoint if useful. Avoid making it the normative owner of every workflow.

candidates.label: Registry semantic router service
candidates.primary_failure_mode: Router/service failure or another unverified policy authority.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat: an external classifier selects EM-06. Spec: it selects file/authoring constraints before native execution.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: the service must preserve task/epoch identity and handle outage/recovery; new operational dependencies appear.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select only after measured scale/selection failures defeat simpler repairs. Avoid without an approved service boundary and maintenance owner.

candidates.label: All detailed rules always on
candidates.primary_failure_mode: Context competition, irrelevant ceremony and duplicated projection drift.
candidates.task_family_walkthrough: Chat and spec both receive the whole detailed corpus before either needs it.
candidates.recovery_walkthrough: Research: early details can still be lost or compete after long context; full loading does not prove adherence.
candidates.decision_trigger: Select only a bounded critical slice supported by evidence. Avoid universal owner-corpus inlining.
